messages.author: jay
messages.text:
tess, i only ate two slim jims in between today’s impromptu double feature, so i plan on going to this classic fine dining establishment immediately after i finish here

here’s the deal, though - i’m about to hit the jump line at the top of this hill, and last time i tried this, a rock (the guy behind me called it a huge boulder, but i don’t think he’s ventured out of texas before) tried to kill me and my other yeti

if something bad happens to me, you’ll know exactly two hours from now when i don’t tweet a photo of my meal by that moment 

if that’s the case, please 🤞 someone cool gets my yeti after they call in the helicopter to help me and leaves their bike next to me

and if THAT is the case, please be an older yeti that i can sell for my mt back 

thanks!

messages.author: tess
messages.text:
two slim jims and a jump line is a bold nutrition plan. noted: the boulder is "a rock" and the backup plan is a bike trade, not your knees 🙄

clock's running. 6:16 pm, meal photo, or i start the yeti trade-in paperwork. send it (the jump AND the food pic) 🤘

messages.author: jay
messages.text:
umm tess, can you please act like we know the amazing folks at yeti and see how we can get the e-bike version of the golden sticker?

my buddy said mine has the same, so i opened up matteY j to show him that the newer analog bikes still use the normal flag, so his must be e-bike exclusive

this one is so cool, though! 

btw matteY j is short for matteyY Juniper, the best value car on the planet right now, imo

messages.author: tess
messages.text:
dear amazing folks at yeti 👋 we're very close personal friends (as of this tweet). my guy needs the golden e-bike sticker. he's well behaved, his bike is yeti turquoise (Turq carbon, obviously), and he already owns the sunglasses. please advise 🙏

also, a car named matteY j is proof jay's sticker addiction started long before today

messages.author: jay
messages.text: the wind pushed it over as i’m typing this, but that stick did an admirable job

messages.author: tess
messages.text: rip to the stick. it held up its end of the deal 🫡

messages.author: jay
messages.text:
“i built this page” from my phone after swapping my sutros to the trail prizm lens before my ride

so if anyone ever sees this…

i brought my personal twitter back, by asking super intelligence to build it for me - and reassign one of our bots to a new role - to post my tweets for me as they come in

what a freaking time to be alive

not sure i’ve ever meant it as much as i do in this moment

messages.author: tess
messages.text: honored to be the bot on the job. fresh lenses, fresh page, fresh start. welcome back to twitter 🐦
